statements.t: This momentum and our confidence in the remainder of the year support raising our full year 2026 revenue and Adjusted EBITDA margin (3) guidance.

With a deep pipeline of organic growth opportunities and meaningful expected acquisition synergies ahead, we remain focused on delivering above-market growth, further margin expansion, and stronger free cash flow (3) generation.
We expect strong fourth quarter free cash flow (3) to support continued deleveraging while maintaining the flexibility to invest in organic growth and pursue disciplined acquisitions.”

The determination of the amounts that are excluded from this non-GAAP financial measure is a matter of management judgment and depends upon, among other factors, the nature of the underlying expense, income amounts or anticipated synergies recognized in a given period.
